title.zh: 所得税（Applied Materials 东南亚私人有限公司——第 19B(10B) 条豁免）命令 2019
title.en: Income Tax (Applied Materials South East Asia Pte Ltd — Section 19B(10B) Exemption) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Applied Materials South East Asia Pte Ltd — Section 19B(10B) Exemption) Order 2019 and is deemed to have come into operation on 18 July 2018.

2.—(1) Applied Materials South East Asia Pte. Ltd. is exempt from section 19B(10A) of the Act in respect of capital expenditure incurred by it on 29 August 2018 in acquiring, for use in its trade or business, intellectual property rights from Applied Materials International Pte. Ltd., being rights acquired from Applied Materials Singapore Technology Pte. Ltd. on 24 August 2018.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter dated 18 July 2018, and email dated 25 July 2018, addressed to Wong & Leow LLC, solicitors for Applied Materials South East Asia Pte. Ltd.
